limits: Fault fixtures do not prove all hardware abort semantics
Shared host and two timing repeats; no universal speedup claim
Rejected experiments passed correctness but produced overlapping or inconsistent timings

experiment_descriptions.speed-connected-timing: Compact memory versus connected callee loops, first batch
experiment_descriptions.speed-connected-timing2: Compact memory versus connected callee loops, repeat
experiment_descriptions.speed-successor-timing: Compact memory versus guarded successor candidates
experiment_descriptions.speed-final-timing: Original pre-fix archive versus compact-memory candidate, failed confirmation
experiment_descriptions.speed-memory-repeat: Fault-fixed baseline versus compact memory, isolation repeat
experiment_descriptions.speed-kept-timing: Original archive versus compact-memory candidate plus sentinel follow-up, failed confirmation; NOT final retained build
experiment_descriptions.live: Final correctness-only build, isolated manual-upload live test
experiment_descriptions.candidate_live: Intermediate compact-memory candidate live test, rejected

outcome: Correctness fixes retained; all three speed prototypes removed; no reliable additional headroom established.
